label: Hands
description: Hands dealt in.

label: bb/100
description: Big blinds won per 100 hands.

label: All-in adjusted bb/100
description: All-in adjusted big blinds won per 100 hands.

label: Showdown bb/100
description: Big blinds won at showdown per 100 hands.

label: Non-showdown bb/100
description: Big blinds won without showdown per 100 hands.

label: C-bet flop
description: Bet the flop as the preflop aggressor when checked to or first to act.
notes: An opportunity is a flop decision with nothing in front, so a flop someone has already led into, and a flop reached all-in preflop where there is no decision to make, are left out rather than counted as a missed c-bet.

label: C-bet turn
description: Bet the turn after c-betting the flop (double barrel).
notes: An opportunity is a turn with nothing in front where this seat was the flop's last aggressor, so a turn led into first, and a turn reached after the flop c-bet was raised and called, do not count.

label: C-bet river
description: Bet the river after barrelling the turn (triple barrel).
notes: An opportunity is a river with nothing in front where this seat was the turn's last aggressor, so a river someone leads into first, and a river reached after the turn bet was raised and called, do not count.

label: Delayed c-bet
description: Bet the turn as the aggressor after checking the flop.
notes: The seat's whole flop line must be a check, so calling a flop lead does not count as having passed up the flop.

label: Fold to c-bet flop
description: Folded facing the preflop aggressor's flop bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front; once another player has raised it, the seat is facing a raise rather than a c-bet and the decision does not count.

label: Call c-bet flop
description: Called facing the preflop aggressor's flop bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front; a c-bet that has already been raised is a different decision and does not count.

label: Raise c-bet flop
description: Raised the preflop aggressor's flop bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front; raising a c-bet another player has already raised is a re-raise and does not count.

label: Fold to c-bet turn
description: Folded facing the preflop aggressor's turn bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front; once it has been raised, the seat is facing a raise rather than a c-bet and the decision does not count.

label: Fold to c-bet river
description: Folded facing the preflop aggressor's river bet.
notes: The c-bet must be the only bet in front; once it has been raised, the seat is facing a raise rather than a c-bet and the decision does not count.

label: Fold to delayed c-bet
description: Folded to the aggressor's turn bet after the flop checked through.
notes: The seat must have checked a flop it faced nothing on, and the aggressor's turn bet must be the only one in front; a bet that has already been raised does not count.

label: Float flop
description: Bet the turn when checked to, after calling a flop bet in position.
notes: The turn must be checked to this seat; a turn the opponent leads into is not a chance to bet and is left out of the opportunities.

label: Float, fold turn
description: Folded to a turn bet after calling a flop bet in position.
notes: Counts in-position turns where a bet is actually faced after calling the flop; a turn that checks through is not a fold-or-continue decision and does not count.

label: Donk bet flop
description: Led into the preflop aggressor on the flop, out of position.
notes: An opportunity is a flop decision out of position with nothing in front; once another player has led, putting money in is a raise and the decision does not count.

label: Fold to donk bet
description: Folded as the preflop aggressor when led into on the flop.
notes: The lead must be the only bet in front; once it has been raised the aggressor is facing a raise, not a donk bet, and the decision does not count.

label: Probe turn
description: Bet the turn out of position after the aggressor checked back the flop.
notes: Only out-of-position turns count; betting into a checked-back flop from in position is a different spot.

label: Fold to probe turn
description: Checked back the flop as the aggressor, then folded to a turn bet.
notes: The seat must have checked a flop it faced nothing on, and the turn bet must be the only one in front; a bet that has already been raised does not count.

label: Probe river
description: Bet the river out of position after the turn checked through.
notes: Only out-of-position rivers count; betting a checked-through turn from in position is a different spot.

label: Fold to probe river
description: Folded as the aggressor to a river bet after the turn checked through.
notes: The seat must have checked a turn it faced nothing on, and the river bet must be the only one in front; a bet that has already been raised does not count.

label: Check-raise flop
description: Raised the flop after checking and facing a bet.
notes: The bet must be the only one in front; once someone has raised it, raising is a re-raise and the decision does not count.

label: Check-raise turn
description: Raised the turn after checking and facing a bet.
notes: The bet must be the only one in front; once someone has raised it, raising is a re-raise and the decision does not count.

label: Check-raise river
description: Raised the river after checking and facing a bet.
notes: The bet must be the only one in front; once someone has raised it, raising is a re-raise and the decision does not count.

label: Fold to flop raise
description: Bet the flop and folded when raised.
notes: Exactly one raise stands in front of this seat's bet; a raise that has itself been re-raised is a different decision and does not count.

label: Fold to turn raise
description: Bet the turn and folded when raised.
notes: Exactly one raise stands in front of this seat's bet; a raise that has itself been re-raised is a different decision and does not count.

label: Fold to river raise
description: Bet the river and folded when raised.
notes: Exactly one raise stands in front of this seat's bet; a raise that has itself been re-raised is a different decision and does not count.

label: Bet-call river
description: Bet the river and called a raise.
notes: Exactly one raise stands in front of this seat's bet; a raise that has itself been re-raised is a different decision and does not count.

label: River raise
description: Raised when facing a river bet.
notes: The bet faced must be the only one in front; facing a bet that has already been raised does not count.

label: River check-fold
description: Checked the river, then folded to a bet.
notes: The bet faced must be the only one in front; a bet that was raised before this seat acted does not count.

label: River check-call
description: Checked the river, then called a bet.
notes: The bet faced must be the only one in front; a bet that was raised before this seat acted does not count.

label: Aggression factor (flop)
description: Bets and raises divided by calls on the flop.

label: Aggression factor (turn)
description: Bets and raises divided by calls on the turn.

label: Aggression factor (river)
description: Bets and raises divided by calls on the river.

label: Aggression factor
description: Postflop bets and raises divided by postflop calls.

label: Aggression frequency (flop)
description: Share of flop actions (checks excluded) that were a bet or a raise.

label: Aggression frequency (turn)
description: Share of turn actions (checks excluded) that were a bet or a raise.

label: Aggression frequency (river)
description: Share of river actions (checks excluded) that were a bet or a raise.

label: Aggression frequency
description: Share of postflop actions (checks excluded) that were a bet or a raise.

label: VPIP
description: Voluntarily put money in the pot preflop, per hand dealt in (blind posts excluded).

label: PFR
description: Raised preflop, per hand dealt in.

label: RFI (open %)
description: Raised when first in, from any position.

label: Steal %
description: Raised first in from the cutoff, button or small blind.

label: Limp %
description: Called the big blind when first in rather than raising.

label: Isolation raise %
description: Raised over one or more limpers with no raise in front.

label: Cold call %
description: Called a raise at the first decision of the hand, not already invested as a blind.

label: Call vs open
description: Called when facing exactly one raise, from any seat (blinds included).
notes: Every decision facing a single raise counts, a limper's included when the raise comes back around, not only a seat's first decision in the hand.

label: Fold vs open
description: Folded when facing exactly one raise, from any seat.
notes: Every decision facing a single raise counts, a limper's included when the raise comes back around, not only a seat's first decision in the hand.

label: 3-bet %
description: Re-raised when facing exactly one raise (a limp-reraise counts).
notes: Every decision facing a single raise counts, a limper's included when the raise comes back around, so a limp-reraise is a 3-bet here.

label: Squeeze %
description: Re-raised facing a raise and at least one cold caller.
notes: Every decision facing a single raise with at least one caller behind it counts, a limper's included when the raise and the calls come back around.

label: Fold to 3-bet
description: Folded after open-raising and facing a 3-bet.
notes: Only the opener's decision with exactly a 3-bet in front counts; folding later in the same hand, having 4-bet into a 5-bet, is a different spot.

label: Call 3-bet
description: Called after open-raising and facing a 3-bet.
notes: Only the opener's decision with exactly a 3-bet in front counts; a later decision in the same hand, facing a 4-bet, is not one of these.

label: 4-bet %
description: Re-raised when facing two raises (the opener's raise over a 3-bet counts).
notes: Every seat facing two raises counts, so the opener re-raising a 3-bet (the ordinary 4-bet) is in the number alongside a cold 4-bet from a seat yet to act.

label: Fold to 4-bet
description: Folded after 3-betting and facing a 4-bet.
notes: Only the 3-bettor's decision with exactly a 4-bet in front counts; a fold to a later 5-bet in the same hand is a different spot.

label: Call 4-bet
description: Called after 3-betting and facing a 4-bet.
notes: Only the 3-bettor's decision with exactly a 4-bet in front counts; a later decision in the same hand, facing a 5-bet, is not one of these.

label: 5-bet %
description: Re-raised when facing three raises (the 3-bettor's raise over a 4-bet counts).
notes: Every seat facing three raises counts, so the 3-bettor re-raising a 4-bet (the ordinary 5-bet) is in the number alongside a cold 5-bet.

label: Fold BB to steal
description: Folded the big blind facing a first-in raise from the cutoff, button or small blind.
notes: The raise must be first in to be a steal, so a late-position raise over limpers is in neither the folds nor the opportunities.

label: Limp, fold to raise
description: Limped, then folded when someone raised behind.
notes: Every limp counts, an over-limp behind another limper as much as the first limp into the pot.

label: Limp, call raise
description: Limped, then called a raise behind.
notes: Every limp counts, an over-limp behind another limper as much as the first limp into the pot.

label: Limp-raise
description: Limped, then re-raised a raise behind.
notes: Every limp counts, an over-limp behind another limper as much as the first limp into the pot.

label: WWSF
description: Won the pot, given the flop was seen.

label: WTSD
description: Reached showdown, given the flop was seen.

label: W$SD
description: Won at showdown, given showdown was reached.
